label: Paste a configuration
hint: A shell alias or export lines, a .env file, Claude Code's settings.json, a curl command or a provider's JSON. It's read when you stop typing, and nothing is saved until you press Save.
hub_old: Couldn't read the text: the hub needs an update first. What you pasted is kept.
read_failed: Couldn't read the text: {error}. What you pasted is kept.
nothing: Nothing in it can be added as a provider.
several: It has {count} providers. Pick the one to add.
matched_one: You already have a provider on this address.
matched_other: You already have {count} providers on this address.
merge_hint: Opens {name} with the new models checked. Its key and other settings stay.
key_hint: Opens {name} with the pasted key. Its models and other settings stay.
new_hint: Starts a new provider with what was read.
provider_missing: Couldn't open {name}: it's no longer among your providers.
